purpose: Governor-operational routes outside the pack OpenAPI contract surface (contracts/v1/openapi.json). Declared here so the full registered surface is explicit and conformance-tested.

routes.purpose: readiness probe (store open, data dir locked)
first-boot workspace bootstrap (unauthenticated only before any workspace exists)
first-boot active release bootstrap (same window as workspace setup)
runner fetches the digest-pinned execution artifact bound into its signed JobOffer
runner asks for the data a governed read tool needs (documents, CSV artifacts, knowledge); the Governor rechecks the live attempt, the agent's tool allowlist and workspace scope, and audits refusals
Brain knowledge/session tools exposed over MCP to agent runtimes
VAPID public key for browser push subscription
register an encrypted-at-rest browser push subscription for the signed-in human
list verified evidence bundles available for governed Board and delivery selection
list staged immutable configuration releases for administrative inspection and activation
create a read-only, expiring, revocable share link for one verified final result version (ADR 0013); the token is returned once
list the share links of a workspace (own links, or all for a workspace admin); never returns a token
revoke a share link at once (its creator or a workspace admin)
public read of the one result a share link names; the token alone authorises it, no session is read; 404 unknown, 410 expired or revoked
the signed-in person's notification channels (in-app always on; push; webhook; daily digest) and which channels the server offers (ADR 0011)
set the signed-in person's push, webhook and digest preferences
